purpose: Bind one immutable task publication generation to the currently winning authorized Issue #240 claim identity, Researcher-ID, theorem-owner classification, execution branch/base, output scope and owner lease without turning GitHub persistence into the research hot path.

claim_envelope_normalization.researcher_id: If absent, derive deterministically from task_id plus claim_id using the existing identity lane.
claim_envelope_normalization.taskbook_blob_sha1: Resolved from the current immutable publication record; callers do not need to duplicate it.
claim_envelope_normalization.lease_minutes: If absent, inherit the task claim lease.

runtime_authorization_gate.event_evidence: One local export of the existing Issue #240 comments at the execution/adoption semantic boundary; canonical dispatch replays authentication, actor authorization, claim-envelope validation and lease reduction locally.

persistence_boundary.claim: One Issue #240 CLAIM is sufficient to begin a registered execution after canonical validation; do not require a prior commit, PR, merge, CI wait, heartbeat, or second GitHub write.
persistence_boundary.execution_authorization_read: At execution start or stale adoption, consume one current Issue #240 comment export and reduce it locally; do not turn this into periodic polling between semantic checkpoints.
persistence_boundary.execution_record: The immutable execution record is durable provenance for result freezing. It may be created locally after CLAIM and batched with the first genuine durable checkpoint or final return; it is not a pre-math remote publication gate.
persistence_boundary.between_checkpoints: Zero routine repository writes, zero CI polling, zero review polling and zero scheduler heartbeat are required solely by this contract.

distributed_transaction: Validate current task publication -> create/verify execution branch -> append one self-contained authorized CLAIM envelope on Issue #240 -> first valid live CLAIM wins -> runtime guard reconstructs that same live winner at execution/adoption boundary -> research -> freeze the matching execution record only when a genuine durable checkpoint/result requires provenance.
compatibility: A previously frozen immutable execution intent may still supply the binding for its matching current-publication CLAIM, but it does not replace the requirement that the live Issue #240 claim itself currently wins the owner race.
